# AgentPress Material Kit: Redis: sync source stats

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/requests/bdbs/sync_source_stats
Ecosystem: Redis
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for cache/queue/vector docs: sync source stats

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
